title: Post-Wedding Expense Reconciliation
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:budget phase=post_event
| stats sum(planned_cost) as planned, sum(actual_cost) as actual by category
| eval variance=round(actual-planned,2)
| sort - variance
description: Reconciles planned versus actual spend for final event closeout after invoices and extras settle.
value: Final cost truth usually arrives after the event; reconciliation turns fuzzy memory into a clean ledger.
implementation: Label post-event budget rows and compare planned versus actual costs by category.
visualization: Table of post-event budget variance by category.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces where the final costs ended up higher or lower than the plan after everything was over.
